business_summary: Asahi Yukizai Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the pipe and fittings system, resin, and water treatment and resource development businesses in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It offers manual and automatic valves, as well as plastic pipes and fittings under the ASAHIAV brand; plastic valves under the Dymatrix brand; flow control systems under the Falconics brand; mixers under the Mixworx brand; and engineering services, including tank design and manufacturing, resin processed product manufacturing, structural and piping stress analysis, and supervisor dispatch, as well as piping design and installation, prefabrication, and checks. The company also provides phenolic resins for casting processes, industrial fields, and photoresists; resin coated sands for casting processes; and urethane insulating materials for housing, construction, and civil engineering sectors. In addition, it is involved in the geological survey consulting, well drilling, and geothermal and hot spring development; design and construction of drinking, industrial, gray, and recycled water, as well as household wastewater; industrial water and wastewater treatment; and maintenance and management services. The company was formerly known as Asahi Organic Chemicals Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Yukizai Corporation in April 2016. Asahi Yukizai Corporation was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Dymatrix 브랜드의 플라스틱 밸브; Falconics 브랜드의 흐름 제어 시스템; Mixworx 브랜드의 믹서; 탱크 설계 및 제조, 수지 가공 제품 제조, 구조 및 배관 응력 분석, 감독자 파견, 배관 설계 및 설치, 사전 제작 및 점검을 포함한 엔지니어링 서비스. 이 회사는 또한 주조 공정, 산업 분야 및 포토레지스트용 페놀수지를 제공합니다. 주조 공정용 수지 코팅 모래; 주택, 건축, 토목분야의 우레탄 단열재 등을 생산하고 있습니다. 또한 지질 조사 컨설팅, 유정 시추, 지열 및 온천 개발에도 참여하고 있습니다. 식수, 공업용수, 중수, 재활용수 및 가정 폐수의 설계 및 건설; 공업용수 및 폐수 처리; 그리고 유지보수
